title: Return Policy
description: Please contact Amazon support before returning an item. Each request is reviewed based on the product and order status.
rules: Contact store support before sending an item back.
Have your order number and product details ready when you contact us.
Keep the product, packaging and included accessories together.
Check product information for any warranty or return conditions.
Report any damage noticed on delivery to the store as soon as possible.
Support will explain the next steps and review outcome.
